showcase_positioning.one_sentence: Taxlane is a guarded fiscal-readiness system that shows source custody, incomplete gates, and blocked claims before any rate or savings output is allowed.

current_showable_surfaces.claim: Taxlane can show which official-source evidence exists, which capture gaps remain, and why missing values stay null.
Taxlane can show a concrete income-security/family readiness trail from federal perimeter custody through CBO, OECD, HHS/ACF, USDA, and Census gaps.
Taxlane can show machine-readable guardrails that block solver inputs, rates, savings, public rate cards, department-cut instructions, technology-savings claims, and balanced-budget claims.

remaining_before_rate_or_savings: complete source custody for remaining lane gates
populate reviewed floor values and pass/fail findings
populate solver input inventory from reviewed evidence
complete assigned receipt bases, distribution/incidence, administration/compliance burden, interaction, and macro feedback
run role review and public-language review
